kumma.p: [Ku+ūmi] (pu) CL=7 [Kara+ma. Kucchito ūmi vego assa kummo. Dhāna,ṭī.674. Karotīti kummo=kacchapo. Moga,7. 137.(kūmī-saṃ)] (1) A Tortoise. A tortoise whose back is a very hard shell. (Ti) (2) (Fives aggregates embodying a being) that is like a tortoise. Kumma(kri) [kara+a+ma] They make. May we do. See - Karoti.

kummagga.p: [Ku+magga] (pu) CL=7 (1) A wrong way that should disgust. A wrong path. (2) The Miccha path that is similar to the wrong way. (3) The wrong belief. See also - Kummaggamicchāmaggapaṭipanna. See - Kummaggapaṭipanna-(2).
a: ကုမ္မဂ္ဂ(ပု)
(၁)စက်ဆုပ်အပ်သော-မှားသော-ခရီးလမ်း၊ လမ်းမှား။(၂)လမ်းမှား,တူသော-မိစ္ဆာမဂ်-အပါယ်လမ်း-အပါယ်ခရီး။(၃)မှားသောအယူ၊ အယူမှား။ ကုမ္မဂ္ဂမိစ္ဆာမဂ္ဂပဋိပန္န-လည်းကြည့်။ ကုမ္မဂ္ဂပဋိပန္န-(၂)-ကြည့်။

kummāsa.p: [Kula+sa] (pu) CL=7 [Kulati pattharatīti kummāso=bhakkhaviseso. Moga,7. 215.] (1) A barley cake or snack. (2) Nipa palm sap (that is a kind of vinegar).

kummaggapaṭipanna.p: [Kummagga+paṭipanna] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who goes the path of the four lower worlds that should be disgusted. (2) One who takes the wrong belief that should be disgusted.

kummāsapiṇḍijātaka.p: [Kummāsapiṇḍī+jātaka] (na) CL=7 Kummāsapiṇḍijātaka. The story is based on Queen Mallikā that is when Lord Buddha dwells in Jetavana monastery, a girl Jetavana offers barley cakes to Lord Buddha. On that day she becomes the Queen of King Kosala.
a: ကုမ္မာသပိဏ္ဍိဇာတက(န)
